Report Description
////MARINE POLLUTION SURVEILLANCE REPORTS /// POSSIBLE OIL OBSERVED IN SATELLITE IMAGERY LOCATED APPROXIMATELY 62 MILES SOUTHEAST OF LEVITTOWN, NY. THE ANOMALY APPEARS TO BE COMING FROM THE COIMBRA SHIPWRECK WHICH IS A KNOWN LEAK SOURCE.. THE ANOMALY IS 7.4 MILES IN TOTAL LENGTH AND 0.20 MILES IN WIDTH. THE SUSPECTED OIL ANOMALY HAS GOOD CONTRAST AGAINST THE OCEAN SURFACE AND EXHIBITS SHARP TURNS. THE DROP OUTS FROM THE SATELLITE IMAGE SEEM TO OBSCURE THE OVERALL EXTENT OF THE OIL. IN ADDITION, OCEAN SWELLS APPEAR NEAR AND SOUTH OF THE AREA OF POSSIBLE OF OIL SHOWING UP AS BRIGHT WHITE LINES IN THE IMAGE. WINDS WERE LIGHT AT LESS THAN 10 KNOTS COMING FROM THE WSW. UNCERTAINTIES: THE DROP OUTS FROM THE SATELLITE IMAGE SEEM TO OBSCURE THE OVERALL EXTENT OF THE OIL; THERE MAY HAVE BEEN ADDITIONAL OIL ALONG THE SOUTHERN EDGE ALTHOUGH THIS AREA DOESN"T HAVE THE SAME APPEARANCE IN CONTRAST WITH ALL THE OTHER ANOMALIES.

SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 44.238056, -76.542222 (Explicit)
Report Description\\ NEEC INCIDENT NOTIFICATION: TRAIN DERAILMENT DANGEROUS GOODS INTO WATER | DUPONT CANADA | KINGSTON, ON \\ AT 10:35 ET ON 05 MAY 2023, A CN RAIL TRAIN DERAILMENT IN KINGSTON, ON (INTERSECTION OF BATH ROAD + ARMSTRONG ROAD) OCCURRED DUE TO A BRIDGE COLLAPSING. THERE ARE 2 DANGEROUS GOODS RAILCARS THAT ARE DANGLING DOWN FROM THE BRIDGE AND MAY POSSIBLY FALL IN THE RIVER. ONE (1) HOPPER CAR CONTAINS A LOAD OF ENVIRONMENTALLY HAZARDOUS SUBSTANCES (SOLID), WHILE THE OTHER RAILCAR CONTAINS A CORROSIVE SOLID PRODUCT. FIRE DEPARTMENT AND POLICE ARE ON SITE.
